description: Manual corrections to the weekly supply-chain report that are not recorded elsewhere. Release tag pins live in release-tags.json and re-run weeks in the data branch; catalog exceptions in tools/*.json need an entry under catalog_exceptions; resolved finding disputes go under disputes (date, repository, advisory, optional package@version, status, summary, pr or link). Rendered at https://rezmoss.github.io/awesome-security-pipeline/corrections/.

entries.summary: The first week was published seven times by scheduled, manual, and push-triggered runs while the report pipeline was being finished. Each publish replaced the previous one without keeping it; every version remains in the supply-chain-data branch history. From 2026-11-08 only scheduled or explicitly dispatched runs publish, and a replaced run is kept under runs/superseded/.

A review of the first week found scanner errors, fixed from the next run: two critical "Malware in ..." matches were false (salesforce/cloudsplaining's own npm package name and a local file: dependency in semgrep/semgrep matched malware published under the same names), four snyk/cli matches were on its own 1.0.0-monorepo workspace package, and 17 matches were on GitHub Actions referenced by a moving tag (v4, release/v1) that follows the latest, fixed release; npm development dependencies were omitted although the method includes them; npm-shrinkwrap.json was not read (AikidoSec/safe-chain showed 7 dependencies); and directories such as integration-tests, test-fixtures, and functional-tests were not excluded as fixtures. The week's data is unchanged; its "changes since last week" compared same-day re-runs and is now shown as a first scan.
